items.title: Commercial furniture moving
items.shortDesc: Heavy, bulky, or delicate — our crews move desks, conference tables, and shared equipment with pad-wrapped protection and proper gear.
items.lede: The core of what we do. Pad-wrapped, route-planned, and handled by crews who move offices for a living — not a side gig.
bullets: Pad-wrap and shrink-wrap protection on every piece
Elevator pads, floor runners, and wall protection on site
Inventory tagging and room-by-room placement
Nights, weekends, and after-hours scheduling

items.title: Office relocation
items.shortDesc: Full-service moves coordinated around your calendar. We plan, label, pack, move, and reset so your team walks into a working office.
items.lede: A single point of contact for the whole move — from the first walkthrough to the Monday-morning restart.
bullets: Move plan, labeling system, and phased schedule
Certificate of Insurance and building coordination
IT equipment handling with disconnect / reconnect support
Reset to spec: everything plugged in and working

items.title: Furniture assembly & installation
items.shortDesc: We read plans, unbox, assemble, level, and finish. Whether it's a single workstation or a full floor, we install it right.
items.lede: We assemble, level, and finish. From one conference table to a whole floor of workstations, we install to spec and leave a clean punch list.
bullets: Installers who read shop drawings and floor plans
All major brands — Herman Miller, Steelcase, Haworth, Knoll, Allsteel
Height-adjustable desks, monitor arms, power & data routing
Debris removal and cardboard recycling included

items.title: Cubicle & modular systems
items.shortDesc: Herman Miller, Steelcase, Haworth, Knoll — we install and reconfigure modular systems to spec, on time, with clean finishes.
items.lede: Panel systems, benching, private offices — we install new, reconfigure existing, and relocate whole pods without losing parts.
bullets: Full panel system installs from pallets to finished floor
Reconfiguration with inventory accounting for every part
Electrical whip coordination with your electrician
Parts sourcing for legacy systems (Ethospace, Action Office, etc.)

items.title: Decommissioning & liquidation
items.shortDesc: When a space is done, we clear it out — disassembly, hauling, donation routing, and broom-swept handoff back to the landlord.
items.lede: When a lease ends, we clear the space. Disassembly, hauling, donation routing, and a broom-swept handoff ready for the landlord walk.
bullets: Inventory assessment and liquidation plan
Donation to nonprofits and schools (with receipts)
Certified recycling for e-waste and metal
Broom-swept delivery ready for landlord inspection
